scenario: Ellipsis `...` is rejected by the lexer per LLEX.8.2.3 — it has no valid production in DS v1 and gives a clearer diagnostic than three separate `.` tokens would. Pin: source containing `...` in an expression context is a parse error.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t where t.v ... 5
->
    log info "x"
